verdict.rationale: Gusto's own press release says developers can install a Gusto CLI in one command or connect through its MCP server (gusto-docs-12). It also describes an agent that prepares work before each payroll and sends a prioritized list of decisions for owner approval (gusto-docs-13). Together these imply programmatic, non-UI operation, but nothing shows the CLI running unattended in CI, and the mandatory owner approval step limits fully headless automation. Missing for 10: documentation of non-interactive or headless CLI use, CI or service-account authentication (API tokens), command reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated runs.
